test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Divergence
solution:
The correct answer is **"Confluence"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options, **"Confluence"** is the most appropriate antonym of the given word.
 
• The word **"Confluence"** means- "to come together, meeting, or gathering at one point".
 
 
• **Example: **The Triveni Sangam is known as the **confluence** point of the rivers- Ganga, Yamuna and Saraswati.
 
 
 
• While the word **"Divergent"** refers to something that moves or extends away from a common point.
 
 
• **Example: **They have a **divergent **political views to those of their unions, each other, and themselves.
 
 
 
• Thus, ***option 4)*** is the correct alternative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let us understand the meaning of other options too.

 
• **Dissonance: **Lack of agreement.
 
• **Separation:** partition
 
• **Departure: **Leaving or signing off
